title: LoRaWAN WoT Binding Form
description: Validation rules for the LoRaWAN binding terms used on a property form within a Thing Description.

lorav:type.description: Wire data type, as an xsd:* alias or a native MultiTech type.

lorav:bitmask.description: Hexadecimal mask selecting a contiguous range of bits.

lorav:length.description: Byte length for variable-length types (string/bytes/hex/base64); -1 means consume the remaining bytes.

lorav:tag.description: Tag value(s), e.g. [channel, type], selecting this value.

lorav:slot.description: 0-based order of this property within its group (multi-field TLV case, flagged group, or match case).

lorav:presenceField.description: Name of the flags property whose bit gates this property's presence (flagged groups).

lorav:presenceBit.description: Bit index in the presence field that must be set for this property to appear.

lorav:switchField.description: Name of the discriminator property whose value selects this property's match case.

lorav:switchValue.description: Discriminator value that selects this property's match case.

lorav:var.description: Discriminator alias for this property, referenced as $var by a match block whose discriminator name differs from the property name.

lorav:padBefore.description: Reserved bytes consumed (skipped) immediately before this property within its sequential group (e.g. padding inside a match case).

lorav:enum.description: Mapping from raw integer (as string key) to label.

lorav:validRange.description: Plausibility range [min, max]; the interpreter flags decoded values outside it.

lorav:ref.description: Input value of a computed property, a $name reference to another property.

lorav:polynomial.description: Coefficient list evaluated against the referenced input value.

lorav:transform.description: Ordered post-processing operations (add/div/mult/round) for a computed value.

lorav:compute.description: Binary operation {op, a, b} over two values or constants.

lorav:guard.description: Conditional gate {when: [...], else: value} for a computed value.
